name: Urea C 13

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hypersensitivity Reactions: Hypersensitivity reactions, including anaphylaxis, have been reported in patients using IDkit Hp. Institute appropriate supportive measures if an allergic reaction occurs. ( 5.1 ) Phenylketonuria: Citrica (citric acid) for oral solution, a component in the IDkit…

summary: Warnings for Urea C 13 report that patients may experience allergic reactions, including a severe and potentially life-threatening reaction called anaphylaxis [3]. The drug's warnings also mention phenylketonuria, which relates to the citric acid solution included in the test kit [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated a low score of 9 for liver risk and a low score of 7 for heart risk [M].
